title: Strategy Analytics Manager
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We are hiring a Strategy Analytics Manager or Senior Manager to own the analytics function dedicated to our Operations department. You will act as the COO’s go-to analytical partner, reporting to the CRO: combining strategic judgement, strong stakeholder management and hands-on technical delivery.

This is both a management and coding role where you will lead a small team while personally delivering high-priority analysis using SQL and Python. You will set the direction and priorities of the Operations analytics function, develop the team and create an effective operating model across Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Science and Operations alongside collaborating closely with directors and heads-of across our operational teams.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. OPERATIONS MI, KPI AND CUSTOMER OUTCOME METRICS OWNERSHIP

You will have full accountability for Operations management information and performance reporting.

You will:

- Own data across front-office and back-office Operations departments

- Define and govern KPIs covering demand, SLAs, throughput, productivity, quality and customer outcomes

- Ensure operational efficiency is balanced with fair, timely and effective outcomes for customers

- Identify where operational processes or service performance are creating customer friction, repeat contact or poor outcomes

- Ensure reporting is accurate, consistent and trusted by senior leadership

- Develop strategic north-star metrics that show whether Operations is becoming more effective and scalable

- Move the function beyond retrospective reporting towards forward-looking insight and decision support

2. WORKFLOW OPTIMISATION AND OPERATIONAL STRATEGY

You will work closely with Operations Directors, Heads of Department, the Operations Transformation Office and Product teams to identify, prioritise and deliver the highest-value operational opportunities.

You will:

- Diagnose bottlenecks, failure demand, customer friction and inefficient workflows

- Work with Transformation and Product to define which problems and opportunities to pursue

- Identify the lowest-hanging fruit and quantify the potential operational and customer value

- Recommend improvements to processes, routing, tooling, products and ways of working

- Define clear hypotheses, baselines and success measures before changes are implemented

- Measure realised impact precisely and determine whether initiatives should be scaled, adjusted or stopped

- Translate analysis into clear decisions, actions and ownership

You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist - experimentation, causal inference, and modeling - and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

title: Long & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role
We are a fast-growing wellness brand rethinking the traditional protein bar - an all-natural, whole-food protein bar using clean, recognizable ingredients. As the brand expands across retail, our founders are documenting the behind-the-scenes journey of building the business - from travelling across the US and supporting retail launches to demos, events, and everyday startup life.
We're looking for a Long & Short-Form Video Editor to turn that raw footage into engaging, story-driven content. This role will primarily focus on editing long-form YouTube-style content , supported by short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the founders' personal social channels.
You'll receive raw footage from the founders and be responsible for turning it into polished, engaging content that captures the personality, energy, and reality of building a fast-growing consumer brand. We're looking for someone who is more than a technical editor - you should understand storytelling, pacing, humour, hooks, and retention , and be able to identify the moments within hours of footage that are actually worth watching.
Work Structure & Requirements

•
Location: Remote / Virtual

•
Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

•
Time Zone: EST business hours

•
Compensation: 8 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities
1. Long-Form Video Editing

• Edit raw founder footage into engaging YouTube-style episodes, typically around 15-25 minutes

• Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, storylines, and narrative arcs

• Turn loosely structured footage into cohesive, entertaining stories

• Cut unnecessary material while maintaining natural pacing and personality

• Add music, sound effects, text, graphics, subtitles, and other elements where appropriate

• Handle basic colour correction, audio cleanup, and overall visual consistency

• Create strong openings and hooks that encourage viewers to continue watching

• Incorporate B-roll and supporting footage to strengthen storytelling

• Manage revisions and deliver polished final edits on schedule

2. Short-Form Content

• Turn long-form footage and standalone clips into TikToks, Instagram Reels, and other vertical content

• Identify short moments that can work independently as compelling social content

• Edit clips with strong hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-native formatting

• Create content for both the brand and the founders' personal accounts

• Develop teasers and cutdowns that help drive audiences toward longer YouTube content

• Repurpose existing footage efficiently to maximise the value of each shoot

3. Content & Editing Workflow

• Organise raw footage, project files, and completed assets in a clear and repeatable system

• Maintain consistent editing styles, fonts, graphics, and visual treatments

• Work closely with the founders to understand their preferred style and continuously refine it

• Manage multiple videos at different stages of the editing process

• Proactively suggest opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content

• Stay current with editing styles and content trends across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

Required Skills & Experience

•
Experience: 3+ years of professional video editing experience

•
Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both long-form and short-form editing; experience editing YouTube, documentary-style, vlog, founder-led, or behind-the-scenes content

•
Storytelling: Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention; ability to take several hours of raw footage and independently determine what should make the final cut

•
Short-Form: Excellent short-form editing instincts for TikTok and Instagram Reels

•

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Frontier AI runs on datacenters, and the world is in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout in a generation. The binding constraint on progress is increasingly everything around the chips: land, power, permits, equipment, and the design and construction of the buildings themselves. Bringing a single site online involves hundreds of people, thousands of components, and decisions that move enormous amounts of capital. Much of that work still runs on spreadsheets and handoffs.

At Anthropic, we're building software and Claude-powered tools to help Anthropic scale out its compute, and we think there's an enormous opportunity to rethink how that work gets done. It's early, it's already having a real impact, and the engineers who join now will shape how one of the most consequential buildouts in the world gets done.

We're looking for strong, versatile software engineers who love building for people doing real work in the physical world. You'll embed with the teams that source sites, design buildings, procure equipment, and manage construction, learn their work deeply, and build the tools and systems they rely on every day. Datacenter experience is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert operators, model a messy domain cleanly, and move fast.

Responsibilities

• Build the core systems that track a datacenter's lifecycle (sites, designs, bills of materials, equipment, and construction progress) in one trusted, permissioned source of truth

• Embed with datacenter, energy, and supply chain teams to understand how the work actually gets done, find the critical path, and build the tools they reach for first

• Bring order to messy data by migrating and reconciling spreadsheets and legacy trackers, and integrate with the industry's tools, like construction management, scheduling, and engineering systems

• Design for trust: fine-grained permissions, auditability, and data quality for information that steers major investment decisions

• Ship early, iterate with users, and cut anything that doesn't help bring compute online sooner

• Partner with research to understand new model capabilities and share where they fall short in engineering-heavy, physical-world domains

You may be a good fit if you

• Have 8+ years of experience building software, with strong full-stack skills and solid grounding in data modeling, APIs, and databases

• Have built software that teams in a physical-world industry depend on, such as datacenters, construction, energy, manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics

• Have a track record of zero-to-one work in startup or startup-like environments

• Are deeply user-centric: you learn the domain from the people doing the work and validate with them before over-investing

• Bring high agency and good judgment about what matters, and hold strong opinions loosely

• Communicate clearly across engineering, operations, and research, and care about the societal impacts of your work

Strong candidates may also have

• Experience in datacenters (at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, operator, utility, or engineering firm), or in adjacent fields like construction, logistics, or legal

• Experience with the domain's tooling, such as construction management (Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud), scheduling (Primavera P6), PLM/BOM, ERP and procure

- Supportare le attività operative e amministrative del team.

- Collaborare con i diversi dipartimenti per assicurare una gestione efficace delle richieste e dei processi.

- Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle attività e dell’esperienza dei nostri clienti.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Appartenenza alle Categorie Protette ai sensi della Legge 68/99.

- Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana, sia scritta che parlata.

- Buona dimestichezza con gli strumenti informatici e digitali.

- Precisione, affidabilità e capacità organizzative.

- Buone capacità comunicative e relazionali.

- Predisposizione alla collaborazione e al lavoro in team.

Da Enpal siamo orgogliosi della diversità del nostro team. description:

Capstone Roofing | Santa Rosa, CA

Capstone Roofing is an established and trusted residential roofing company serving homeowners throughout Santa Rosa and the North Bay region of California. This is a full-time, exempt outside sales position working directly with homeowners throughout Santa Rosa and the surrounding North Bay area.

You will run sales leads, meet with homeowners at their properties, inspect roofing systems, prepare estimates and proposals, and present roofing solutions directly to the homeowner.

You do not need to come to us as a roofing expert. Capstone provides a structured training program that combines classroom instruction with hands-on field training. We will teach you our roofing products, inspection and estimating process, sales system, proposal process, and customer service standards.

We are looking for someone who is motivated to succeed, comfortable talking with homeowners, and willing to learn and follow a proven process.

COMPENSATION

• $40,000 base salary
• 2% commission on each sold job with uncapped earning potential
• $500 monthly vehicle allowance
• Company-provided fuel card
• Full benefits package
• Long-term career and advancement opportunities

This compensation structure provides the stability of a base salary along with uncapped commission earning potential based on your sales performance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Run sales leads and meet with homeowners throughout the Santa Rosa and North Bay market
• Conduct residential roof inspections and evaluate homeowners' roofing needs
• Safely use a ladder and access residential roofs as part of the inspection and estimating process
• Take measurements, photos, and gather information needed to prepare accurate estimates
• Develop professional roofing estimates and proposals
• Present proposals directly to homeowners and explain products, scope of work, pricing, and next steps

• Classroom-based roofing and sales training
• Hands-on field training
• Roof inspection and estimating instruction
• Ride-alongs with experienced team members and leadership
• Proposal and presentation training
• Customer communication and sales process training
• Ongoing coaching and professional development

You bring the attitude, effort, communication skills, and willingness to learn. We will provide the training and tools to help you become successful in roofing sales.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We care more about work ethic, coachability, professionalism, accountability, and the ability to build relationships than having years of previous roofing experience.

Successful candidates will be:

title: Generation Lead, Fuel-Based Generation
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Power Generation Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Build an islanded grid at gigawatt scale, from a blank sheet. Generation, storage and compute running with no utility behind them, where the machine you design is the only thing holding voltage. No playbook exists at this size, so the architecture you set becomes the reference.

- Get power online in months, not years. Interconnection queues are measured in years and we do not have them. Generating our own power is how a site goes from signed lease to live compute inside six months, and the power system is the long pole in that plan.

- Make one power block, then build it a thousand times. A repeatable block and cluster unit, validated once and stamped across the fleet, is the only route to the scale we are targeting. Every bespoke site is schedule we do not get back.

- Design a grid whose largest load answers back. Compute is not passive demand here. Load behaviour, curtailment and shedding are design variables you negotiate and specify, a lever almost no power system engineer has ever been handed.

Role Scope

- Assess and qualify every fuel-oxidation generation technology worth considering for our blocks, from reciprocating engines and turbines to linear generators, and build the qualified technology and supplier list Fluidstack buys from.

- Set the standard interface that turns any engine, turbine or fuel cell into one interchangeable node in the site's decentralized generation array, with a defined electrical connection, control signals, telemetry and operating envelope, so the plant controller dispatches it alongside PV and BESS without bespoke integration.

- Decide how much fuel-based capacity each block carries, in what unit sizes and with what redundancy, for its firming and backup role, and hold that decision against cost, fuel use and uptime as the block design evolves.

- Write the technical specification and acceptance tests for each qualified unit, covering step-load acceptance, ramp rate, minimum load, start reliability, heat rate across the load range and emissions, and witness factory and site acceptance before a unit is accepted.

- Own installation and commissioning of the generation fleet through first fire, load testing against real AI load profiles and handover, and fold every field finding back into the specification.

title: Fire Alarm Designer
description:
Wachter's greatest asset is the people who work here. Join the Wachter family and chart your career path!

Wachter is accepting applications for Fire Alarm Designer positions in our Engineering and Design department. This role is responsible for designing and developing fire alarm systems for commercial and industrial projects, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and customer requirements.

Ideal candidates will hold a NICET Level 4 Fire Alarm Systems certification. We will consider a NICET level 3 candidate if you are open to getting your Level 4 certification asap.

Candidate must possess equivalent fire alarm design experience with a strong understanding of NFPA codes, AHJ requirements, and industry best practices. Experience designing fire alarm systems for retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site deployments is highly preferred.

We seek self-motivated and reliable candidates who can work independently and find solutions to complete the job. Long-term employment with competitive pay and exceptional benefits for qualified candidates. We value relationships and invest in our employees.

Qualifications:

• NICET Level 3, (preferably a NICET Level IV) Fire Alarm Systems certification required, or equivalent experience in fire alarm system design and engineering.

• Minimum 2 years of experience designing commercial and/or industrial fire alarm systems.

• Strong working knowledge of NFPA 72, NFPA 70 (NEC), IBC, IFC, and applicable local codes and AHJ requirements.

• Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and other design software used for fire alarm system layout and documentation.

• Experience developing complete construction drawing packages, including floor plans, riser diagrams, battery calculations, voltage drop calculations, device layouts, and equipment schedules.

• Familiarity with major fire alarm manufacturers such as Notifier, Siemens, Edwards, Simplex, Honeywell, Bosch, or equivalent platforms.

• Ability to review architectural, electrical, and mechanical drawings and coordinate fire alarm designs with other building systems.

• Experience supporting permit submissions and responding to plan review comments from AHJs and third-party reviewers.

• Strong understanding of voice evacuation systems, mass notification systems, and networked fire alarm systems.

• Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining design quality.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.

Responsibilites:

• Design complete fire alarm and emergency communications systems in accordance with NFPA, NEC, IBC, IFC, local codes, and customer specifications.

• Prepare detailed construction drawings, submittal packages, device layouts, riser diagrams, sequence of operations, battery calculations, voltage drop calculations, and equipment schedules.

• Review architectural, electrical, mechanical, and site plans to develop code-compliant fire alarm system designs.

description:

EIN- UND AUSTRITTE VON MITARBEITENDEN

GERÄTEVERWALTUNG

- Du verwaltest alle Geräte in NinjaOne. Dazu gehören Überwachung, Updates und Softwareverteilung.

NETZWERK UND BÜRO-IT

DU PASST, WENN DU

- vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin (Prenzlauer Berg) arbeiten willst.

- sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch sprichst.

- eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation hast. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso.

- mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Google Workspace mitbringst.

- NinjaOne oder vergleichbare Software wie Jamf oder Intune kennst.

- dich mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager auskennst.

- Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik hast, idealerweise mit UniFi.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.

- MacBook & Studio Display.

- Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus.

- Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

- Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team: In den letzten 3 Jahren zur zweitgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands mit rund 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern.

- Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor 3 Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor 2 Jahren Chief of Staff.

description:

Are you looking for a great Online Teaching job? Jade Class Education Singapore is hiring energetic, confident & adaptable educators for their upcoming English-language programs! Pay is very competitive at 75-100 USD per class (covers prep time, pre-class recorded practice + live class). We are looking for top quality teachers who will be able to commit to a fixed schedule of classes running from early September through January, with further opportunities available in the spring. NOTE: We will not consider your application without a video introduction!!!
School Description
JadeClass Education Singapore provides enrichment education to bright students who already have a good command of the English language and plan on continuing their education abroad. Our students vary in age from 6-16 and are carefully screened for English level, behavior, and motivation. We focus on teaching concrete skills that will help students in their learning endeavors.
We are seeking talented teachers to deliver live online classes based on materials and instructions prepared by our development staff.
Job Responsibilities

• Deliver engaging high-energy online classes in a 1 on 8 format

• Review materials and participate in practice sessions to ensure quality

• Complete a series of classes without absences or rescheduling

Schedule
For the Spring 2027 semester, classes will run from late February through late June with teaching days on Friday evenings, Saturdays, and Sundays.
February - June: Fri 16:30 - 20:30 (UTC+8)
Sat, Sun 08:30 - 20:30 (UTC+8)
Course Description
Our Small Group Online Courses place one teacher with a group of eight students for a course of study. Each week, the class meets online on the ClassIn (classin.com) platform for two 90-minute lessons. Lessons are fully prepared by our design team, and recordings of the lesson from past semesters are provided to clarify teaching expectations. Interaction with students includes multiple choice activities, student-submitted written work, and direct oral interaction.
Compensation

• 66 USD per hour for each new lesson taught: $100 per 90-minute lesson.

• The payment is for the actual teaching of the lesson. Additional time must be spent reviewing the material, preparing for and recording a demo (without students) to show that you are fully prepared to teach the class.

• 50 USD per hour for each repeated lesson taught (i.e. lessons you have already taught previously): $75 per 90-minute lesson

Remuneration is through Wise (wise.com), monthly, between the 10th and the 12th of the month.
Applicant Requirements

• Able to guarantee preparation for and attendance at each scheduled lesson

• Fun personality, talkative

• Logical, able to explain concepts clearly and simply

• A good imitator, able to watch others teach and emulate them

• Neat and professional appearance

• Positive attitude

• Malleable, willing to change to meet standards

• Perfect Oral Grammar, Precise Diction, Clear Enunciation

Technology Requirements

• Fast, reliable internet (~20mbps up and down)

• Modern, reliable computer (~10,000+ on www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu_list.php)

Application Process
If you are interested in applying, please send the following to us at :
· Your resume
· A link to your introduction video (Vimeo, YouTube, Google, or other safe platforms). The video can be 1-2 minutes in length, telling us a bit about your education and teaching background. If you send us a video file instead of a link, please make sure it is smaller than 20MB.
· Where you saw our job posting
· The name of the position for which you wish to apply
Please understand that due to the high volume of applications, we are only able to consider applicants who submit all the information listed above. Thank you for your interest in JadeClass Education!

title: Senior Linux BSP Engineer
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. We are looking for an experienced Senior Android BSP Engineer to join a long-term international engineering project focused on the development of next-generation embedded Android/Linux platforms for advanced professional products used worldwide.
As part of the firmware engineering team, you’ll work on sophisticated control systems, digital media, and unified communications solutions deployed in conference rooms, classrooms, auditoriums, home offices, and enterprise environments . These are real, commercially deployed products where platform performance, multimedia quality, reliability, and hardware/software integration truly matter .
Work Deep Inside the Android Platform
This is not typical Android application development. You’ll work close to the hardware and deep within the Android platform , contributing to BSP development, platform integration, optimization, debugging, and system-level problem solving.
You’ll investigate problems that rarely have simple answers-working across multiple layers of the system to understand what is happening, why it is happening, and how to solve it properly .
Real Engineering Ownership
You’ll work directly with real hardware and real product environments , collaborating with experienced hardware, firmware, Android, Linux, and application engineers across multiple countries.
Your contribution will go beyond implementing predefined tasks. We value engineers who can analyze complex technical problems, propose solutions, make sound engineering decisions, and take ownership from investigation through implementation and validation .
You’ll also have the opportunity to exchange knowledge with highly experienced engineers and deepen your expertise across Android internals, BSP development, embedded Linux, multimedia, and hardware/software integration .
Why This Project?
If you enjoy bringing up hardware, debugging across the Android stack, optimizing complex embedded systems, and solving the difficult problems that sit between hardware and software , this is an opportunity to work on technically challenging products while continuing to grow as a senior Android platform engineer.
Required Expertise
Must have

• 8+ years of proven experience developing, customizing, and debugging embedded software / firmware for Linux and/or Android-based products .

• Strong programming skills in C/C++ within embedded or system-level development environments.

• Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux development on ARM-based platforms , including configuration, build, deployment, hardware interfaces, and platform bring-up.

• Experience with Linux Kernel , U-Boot , Device Tree , and low-level platform customization.

• Practical experience with device driver development , optimization, troubleshooting, bug fixing, and adding new functionality for areas such as display , power management , Wi-Fi , GPIO , or other hardware interfaces.

• Hands-on experience with Android HAL and the ability to debug issues across the Android Framework and Linux Kernel layers.

• Good understanding of AOSP architecture and Android platform development workflows.

• Strong understanding of recent Android versions , features, APIs, and changes, preferably Android 14 or later .

• Experience working with source control and Android development tools such as Git , Gerrit , GitHub , ADB , and Fastboot .

• Ability to debug embedded systems where traditional step debugging may be limited or unavailable.

From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

You will work at the intersection of AI, developer experience, and platform engineering, building the AI-powered tools and the platform that let teams across Docker prototype, deploy, and scale their own AI developer tools.

As a Staff Engineer you will own the technical design and delivery for two areas:

AI-Powered Developer Tools. Design and build AI agents and tools that accelerate developer productivity, surface observability insights, and automate operational reviews. Examples include AI-powered code review and refactoring assistants, automated test generators and local environment setup tools, deployment pipeline diagnostic agents, and agents that simplify on-call work during incidents.

Self-Service AI Developer Tools Platform. You are a hands-on technical leader who works well at the intersection of AI, developer experience, and platform engineering. You think in platforms: you design something once so that several teams can move faster. You have clear opinions about what makes a developer tool good, and sound judgment about when to build, when to integrate, and when not to do either. You are comfortable in a fast-moving AI landscape and balance technical quality with shipping iteratively. Before you design, you ask about scale, users, and constraints rather than assuming them. You lead through influence and mentorship, and the engineers around you get better because you are on the team.

title: Senior/Lead DevOps / Observability Engineer
description:
About the client
Our client is a leading European online car marketplace, connecting car buyers and sellers across the continent. The platform serves over 30 million monthly users and operates across 18 countries, making it one of the largest and most trusted digital marketplaces for vehicles in Europe.
About the role
We are looking for a hands-on Observability / SRE Engineer with strong AWS infrastructure and networking skills to lead a focused, time-boxed migration of the monitoring setup for one application from New Relic to Grafana. You will be embedded in the client's engineering team, while owning the migration end to end and working independently as the sole engineer on this scope.
This is a short-term engagement with a clear deliverable. We value someone who can ramp up quickly, use modern AI-assisted tooling to move faster, communicate proactively with the team, and leave behind a clean, well-documented monitoring setup.
Responsibilities

• Assess the existing New Relic monitoring setup for the in-scope application, including dashboards, alerts, SLIs/SLOs, synthetic checks, and log and trace usage.

• Define the migration approach and map New Relic constructs to their Grafana-stack equivalents (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo or similar).

• Rebuild dashboards and alert rules in Grafana, validating that coverage and alert quality match or improve on the current state.
Instrument and configure the application and its AWS infrastructure (such as compute, containers, load balancers, and managed services) to send metrics, logs, and traces to the new platform, using OpenTelemetry where applicable.

• Set up and validate secure network connectivity between AWS workloads and the Grafana stack, including VPC routing, security groups, VPC endpoints or PrivateLink, and DNS, and troubleshoot connectivity and data-flow issues.

• Run the old and new monitoring in parallel, verify data accuracy, and manage a safe cutover with minimal risk to production visibility; integrate and tune alerting with the team's incident and notification channels.

• Use AI-assisted development tools, including Codex, to improve engineering productivity and delivery speed, for example to translate queries, generate dashboards and configuration as code, and draft documentation, while reviewing and validating all output.

• Document the new setup, hand over knowledge to the team with runbooks, and keep stakeholders informed with regular progress updates and early risk flags.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or observability engineering, ideally in a high-traffic, cloud-based production environment.

• Strong hands-on experience with Grafana, including dashboard design, alerting, and data source configuration.

• Practical experience with New Relic (APM, dashboards, NRQL, alert policies) and a clear understanding of how to translate it to other tools.

• Experience with Prometheus (PromQL), log and trace tooling such as Loki, Tempo, or the ELK stack, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

• Solid hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, such as EC2, EKS/ECS, IAM, CloudWatch, and S3, and with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).

• Strong understanding of AWS networking, including VPC design, subnets, routing, security groups, load balancers, VPC endpoints/PrivateLink, and DNS (Route 53).

• Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as Codex, in day-to-day engineering work.

• Proven ability to work independently and deliver within a tight timeline, with availability to work full-time within Canadian time zone hours and start on short notice.

• Excellent verbal and written English skills.

Nice to have

• Experience with Grafana Cloud or Grafana Mimir.

• Previous monitoring or observability tool migration projects.

• Experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets.

• AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Advanced Networking)

NB! Working hours according to the Canadian Timez

title: Security & Threat Operations Manager
description:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role
DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Security & Threat Operations Manager to build and mature the function protecting our brokerage platform and corporate environment. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will grow and lead the team, establish its operating model and roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements in threat detection, investigation, incident response, and exposure management.
In this hands-on leadership role, you will own detection content and the exposure management lifecycle, security monitoring and incident response, operation and tuning of security controls, and turn threat intelligence into defensive improvements. You will act as Incident Commander during significant security incidents and coordinate response across technical and business teams. Partnering with Security Engineering, DevOps & Platform, and Product & Engineering, you will ensure defenses evolve along with our AWS platform, Kubernetes services, low-latency trading infrastructure, and corporate technology within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.
What You’ll Do
Program Maturity & Team Leadership

• Program Development: Mature Security & Threat Operations through a measurable roadmap, defined operating model, appropriate monitoring coverage, escalation procedures, and service provider oversight.

• Team Development: Grow and lead the team through hiring, coaching, training, career development, and performance management.

Threat Detection, Investigation & Intelligence

• Detection Engineering: Own the detection program incorporating threat intelligence, content development, proactive hunting, and validation through attack simulations and purple-team exercises. Treat detection content development as an engineering discipline.

• Monitoring & Investigation: Own security monitoring and investigation across product and corporate environments, including phishing, malware, credential compromise, API abuse, DDoS, and insider threats.

• Digital Risk Monitoring: Own digital risk monitoring covering external attack surfaces, leaked credentials, exposed data, impersonation, phishing domains, and takedown coordination.

Incident Response

• Automated Response: Partner with Security Engineering to build pre-defined automated security response actions. Coordinate with business leaders on required response actions which cannot be automated or which require compensating actions to prevent unnecessary business disruption.
